description: Sidewalks is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. Inventory of absent and existing sidewalks, driveways and pedestrian facilities for the City of Austin. This layer depicts an inventory of sidewalk infrastructure. This data was collected in 2006/2007 as part of the sidewalk master plan. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are sidewalk, transportation, agoltosocrata, infrastructure, mobility. The table has 62 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
